Title: Maintenance Proposals Current State
Content: The /proposals workbench is the authenticated approval surface for maintenance-agent write proposals. MaintenanceProposalWorkflow persists proposal JSON through FileMaintenanceProposalStore, records open/respond/approve/reject/revision history, applies approved file changes only after current file content still matches the proposal before-text, and blocks closed proposal changes. The Proposals UI lists proposals, shows diff/evidence/comments/topic-map tabs, can run maintenance tasks, and shows recent maintenance task activity from MaintenanceAgentService.ListRecentActivityAsync. Maintenance runs write latest-run state to LastRunPath and append compact JSONL activity summaries with task names, finding/proposal counts, proposal ids, warnings, and skipped status to ActivityLogPath. The activity panel shows proposal-id drilldown buttons that select matching proposals in the detail pane. MaintenanceAgentConfigService resolves optional Admin Models assignments for maintenance runs, proposal reviews, and Admin Maintenance chat before falling back to the legacy maintenance provider/model fields. The Admin Maintenance tab lets admins send non-mutating maintenance-agent messages through MaintenanceAgentService.SendAdminMessageAsync and search recent transcript entries from TranscriptLogPath; this chat records operational Q&A but does not write memories/pages, approve proposals, or apply file changes. Transcript writes retain up to TranscriptRetentionEntries JSONL entries and redact common token/API key/secret/password/authorization patterns when TranscriptRedactionEnabled is true. The Request Agent Review button calls MaintenanceAgentService.ReviewProposalAsync. Review execution records agent_review_requested and agent_review_completed history/comments without changing the original proposal status; when the provider returns a valid revised proposal, SubmitAgentRevisionAsync saves the revision with metadata.supersedes and records agent_revision_proposed on the original while keeping both proposals reviewable.
